page_subtitle: All Silo plugin APIs, documented and interactive
sec_info_desc: Read-only object with system data. Available in service.js immediately on startup. Use for logging, feature detection, or displaying version info to users.
sec_info_explain: Contains version, OS, CPU count, and the plugin's own ID. Values are populated by the core before service.js executes.
sec_web_desc: Register HTTP endpoints and serve static files. Every route must be whitelisted in info.yaml routes[]. If not listed — request is silently dropped. Supported methods: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS. Also any() for all methods and route(method, path, fn).
sec_web_url_desc: All plugin routes live under /plugins/<plugin_id>/. Example: registering ts.web.staticDir("/css", "css") makes files available at /plugins/example-plugin/css/. In HTML and JS files use relative paths (e.g. css/style.css, js/app.js) — they resolve correctly because the browser sees the page at /plugins/example-plugin/. Never use absolute root paths like /css/style.css — they resolve to the server root, not the plugin.
sec_web_url_example_text: this plugin is at /plugins/example-plugin/. Write <link href="css/style.css"> (relative) or href="/plugins/example-plugin/css/style.css" (absolute).
sec_web_body: parsed body: JSON object, form object, or raw string
sec_bus_desc: Publish/subscribe messaging. Plugins communicate via named topics. Topics must be declared in info.yaml events[] — undeclared topics are denied at runtime. Own plugin topics (plugin:<id>:*) are always allowed.
sec_bus_demo_hint: Demo: Enter a topic and payload, click "Emit". The event goes to the server-side bus and is recorded. Polling fetches the last emitted event from the server.
sec_storage_desc: BoltDB-backed key-value store. Keys are prefixed with <plugin_id>: so plugins never collide. Strings only — use JSON.stringify/parse for objects. Persists across restarts.
sec_http_desc: Make outbound HTTP requests. Both GET and POST supported. Useful for fetching metadata, third-party APIs, or connectivity checks. SSRF protection is handled by the core.
sec_torrent_desc: Full torrent lifecycle: add, list, get status, remove. Works with magnets or info hashes. All operations are scoped to a user (default: "owner").
sec_users_desc: Read-only access to the user list. Useful for access-control decisions. Returns user objects with id, username, rank (0=guest, 10=user, 50=admin, 100=owner), is_banned, created_at.
sec_i18n_desc: Plugins can add translations via static i18n/<lang>.json files (loaded automatically) AND programmatically via ts.i18n.add/addMany in service.js. Both merge into the global i18n registry served as /i18n.js. Later plugins override earlier ones.
i18n_dynamic_fallback: This key was not found in any translation file — i18n returned the key itself as fallback.
i18n_dynamic_found: This key was found in the translation system (added dynamically via ts.i18n.add in service.js).
sec_manifest_desc: Every plugin has an info.yaml. Think of it as a contract: fields you declare grant permission to use those APIs. Undeclared routes or events are silently denied at runtime.
manifest_id_desc: Unique identifier. URL prefix, VFS namespace, storage prefix. Lowercase, no spaces.
manifest_name_desc: Human-readable name for admin UI and plugin lists.
manifest_version_desc: Semantic version shown in admin panel.
manifest_author_desc: Author credit shown in admin panel.
manifest_entry_desc: Path to main JS file. Executed once on startup.
manifest_theme_desc_1: If true, plugin REPLACES the root page at
manifest_theme_desc_2: . Only one plugin can be theme.
manifest_icon_desc: Path to icon inside plugin's VFS. Shown in admin plugin list.
manifest_menu_desc: Sidebar navigation entries. Each: title, route, rank, icon. User sees only where user.rank >= entry.rank.
manifest_routes_desc_2: for prefix matching. Unlisted → silently dropped.
sec_vfs_desc: Read-only access to files bundled inside the plugin itself. The core exposes them through an isolated virtual file system (fs.FS): either the plugin's folder or its ZIP archive. Paths are relative, forward-slash only. Traversal outside the plugin is impossible — the VFS itself rejects it.
sec_vfs_api_note: read/stat/list throw a JS exception on error. Wrap in try/catch or check with exists() first.
